kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text: We've received notice that the Department of Commerce has lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5. We'll begin restoring access tomorrow, and will share an update soon.
kept_items.selection_reason: Top AI story of the day by engagement (8.2M views). Concrete official announcement: US Commerce lifts export controls on both Fable 5 and Mythos 5. Distinct from 2026-06-27 Mythos-5-only item because it is the full reversal covering both models.

kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text: Claude Fable 5 will be available again globally tomorrow. After a series of productive conversations with the US government, we're redeploying the model with a new set of classifiers to target and block more cybersecurity tasks.
kept_items.selection_reason: Operational follow-up with distinct concrete substance (new classifiers blocking cybersecurity tasks, global redeployment timing). Second Anthropic item, within 1-2 author cap; strongest distinct angle from the export-lift announcement.

kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: We're introducing GeneBench-Pro, a research-level benchmark for how well agents can navigate messy biological data, choose the right analysis path, and make judgment calls that real computational research depends on.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete official benchmark release from OpenAI, biology/agents focus. Distinct from recent digests.

kept_items.author: github
kept_items.text: AnthropicAI's Claude Sonnet 5 is now generally available and rolling out in GitHub Copilot. Strong results across coding scenarios, particularly CLI-style tasks; excellent prompt-cache utilization.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete product availability news: Claude Sonnet 5 GA in GitHub Copilot with specific eval notes. New model not covered in prior digests.

kept_items.author: NotebookLM
kept_items.text: Introducing Short Video Overviews in NotebookLM! Turn your most complex sources into 60-second, vertical videos. Rolling out to Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers on mobile and web.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete Google product launch (1M views). Distinct feature, well-sourced from official account.

kept_items.author: DavidSacks
kept_items.text: A new study of 21,559 firms in the U.S. finds that companies that adopt AI tend to grow faster following adoption. Firms making the largest AI investments grow employment by roughly 10% following adoption, while low-intensity adopters see no gain.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete data point: study of 21,559 firms on AI adoption and employment growth. Strong engagement, distinct topic (labor/economics).

kept_items.author: WeinsteinOmri
kept_items.text: A prover-verifier LLM loop harness solved 9 substantial open problems in Theoretical Computer Science, including one that kept the author up for 2 years. Changed his mind on whether LLMs can do general math research.
kept_items.selection_reason: Strong practitioner/research observation from a domain expert on LLMs solving open CS problems via prover-verifier loop. High engagement, concrete claim.

kept_items.author: AndrewCurran_
kept_items.text: OpenAI has found a way to cut inference costs in half.
kept_items.selection_reason: Reported concrete OpenAI development (inference cost halved) from a credible AI-news account. Strong engagement.

kept_items.author: 0xMovez
kept_items.text: Head of Codex: 90% of the entire OpenAI company uses Codex, not just engineers. An agentic loop does 40% of the coding at Codex.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete practitioner detail quoting Head of Codex on internal usage and agentic coding share. Distinct data point on adoption.

kept_items.author: steipete
kept_items.text: Price per token != cost per task.
kept_items.selection_reason: Sharp practitioner observation on the economics of LLM pricing that resonated (108K views). Distinct analytical angle.

kept_items.author: levie
kept_items.text: Box ran Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5 through its AI Complex Work Eval agentic benchmark. Sonnet 5 holds frontier-class quality on complex multi-step enterprise document work and pulls ahead of Sonnet 4.6 in several areas.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete third-party eval result for Claude Sonnet 5 from Box CEO. Complements the Sonnet 5 GA item with independent benchmarking.
